implementationSummary.readTracking: PUT /api/doctor/messages/{deliveryId}/read records first ReadAtUtc for owned current-day Active, Accepted, or Rejected deliveries without financial mutation.
implementationSummary.interactionSettlement: POST /api/doctor/messages/{deliveryId}/interact requires Idempotency-Key, validates Accept/Reject plus feedback, atomically charges company Reserved funds, credits Doctor Available earnings, records interaction evidence, and writes safe audit evidence.
implementationSummary.idempotency: Same-key same-content and different-key matching settled requests replay; conflicting same-key/different-key requests return safe conflict without duplicate settlement.
implementationSummary.replayVerification: Settled replay requires matching Charge/Earn transactions and matching ledger entries; partial replay evidence is treated as a safe settlement anomaly.
implementationSummary.negativeFlows: Expired, released, stale-date, cross-owner, unauthorized, invalid snapshot, and invalid wallet states return safe envelopes and do not mutate settlement state.
